inpi_source.declared_underlying_source: INPI tabulation, based on INEGI Censo de Población y Vivienda 2020. Muestra censal. Microdatos.
inpi_source.explicit_license_status: No dataset-specific reuse license found in the downloaded landing page or workbook. Do not label the INPI XLSX as CC-BY or as covered by a separately verified INPI open-data license.

required_practices: Attribute INEGI and the original census product.
Retain metadata and acknowledge changes, analysis and transformations.

portal_terms_attempt.direct_public_download_result: Challenge Validation HTML, not terms content

publication_handling.recommended: Publish extracted numerical facts and independently authored visualization/metadata; attribute INPI based on INEGI; link to the official workbook download. Keep downloaded source XLSX locally as audit evidence.
publication_handling.source_attribution: INPI, Sistema Nacional de Información y Estadística sobre los Pueblos y Comunidades Indígenas y Afromexicanas, based on INEGI, Censo de Población y Vivienda 2020, Muestra censal, Microdatos.
publication_handling.count_handling: All counts are directly published sample estimates extracted from INPI cells. No counts are inferred from rounded percentages.
publication_handling.share_handling: Shares are calculated as count / corresponding published private-dwelling age 3+ denominator. All percentages and confidence intervals identify the INPI source.

remaining_limitations: A license allowing full republication of the INPI workbook has not been verified.
INEGI and INPI publish slightly different 90% interval endpoints despite identical denominators and matching rounded point estimates. The extraction retains each publication separately.
